businessRules: Published ≠ access: publishing or releasing never grants anyone access.
Progress is per format; there is no overall completion verdict.
Scores and pass criteria belong to one assessment.
Correction Release / Hold: Super Admin only — never called “Publish”.
Device transfer = authorisation of a different device, not shipping; approve only.
Feedback: one record per Student × Experiment × format, offered only after that format is Completed.
“Composite Wall Conduction” and “Conduction Through a Composite Wall” are two sample records until OD-B5-09 is decided — no merge, no duplicate rule.
